package.name: Workshop Electronics
package.description: Electronics with the parts: KiCad boards read without KiCad (outline, cut-outs, mounting holes, tall parts), enclosures round them, PCB order packages for the board house (nothing uploaded or ordered), channels inside printed parts for wire or conductive traces. Its own workbench (Workshop Electronics) with a KiCad board task panel; a Python API (workshop_electronics.api); tools for agents through Agent Link for FreeCAD when it is installed. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the FreeCAD project or the FPA.

workbench.name: Workshop Electronics
workbench.description: A KiCad board read into the document as a solid, ready for an enclosure round it.
